question.text: The chapter describes which strategy as aiming for 'riskless profit, independent of stock price movements'?

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 10.1.3 verbatim: Convertible Arbitrage is 'pursued to earn a riskless profit, independent of stock price movements'. In practice, this is a theoretical ideal; real-world carries market, credit, liquidity risk. The Trap: Others have directional or event-driven risk explicitly. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C same. XV also covers convertible valuation.
